batting.dismissal: c SL Malinga b MM Patel

batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b SL Malinga

batting.dismissal: c YK Pathan b L Balaji

batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b SP Narine

batting.name: AT Rayudu
batting.dismissal: st BB McCullum b Shakib Al Hasan

batting.name: KA Pollard
batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b JH Kallis

batting.name: Harbhajan Singh
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b SP Narine

batting.name: SL Malinga
batting.dismissal: c MK Tiwary b L Balaji

batting.name: RP Singh
batting.dismissal: c Iqbal Abdulla b SP Narine

balls.text: Narine's beaten again outside off, swinging wildly, Karthik collects and runs forward to prevent the bye. Again the batsmen don't attempt to steal a bye. Odd, odd cricket.

he's beaten again, they've got to try and steal a leg by surely? But they don't try. Narine slogged at a good length ball and missed. Karthik would have probably run out a batsman but they had to try and get Yusuf on strike?
Narine backs away towards leg and slogs, head all over the place, bat flailing. He makes contact though, a handy outside edge too for KKR. The ball races to the third man boundary
he's beaten, a short ball and Narine tries to pull, another ball Yusuf is off strike for
full ball outside off, Yusuf drives to long-on where Rohit fields

Yusuf tries to swing the first ball behind square, it was on a length and pitched outside leg stump. Yusuf missed but the ball thudded into the pad and went behind square. Yusuf wanted to keep strike and came back for the second. He was just home before Karthik broke the stumps, safe by a frame.
shot! Narine jams his bat down at a full ball outside off and opens the face deftly, he's placed it behind point and in front of third man
the yorker is down leg side, Narine shuffles out of the way
good length and straight, Yusuf defends towards cover and runs
the slower ball outside off, Yusuf swings across the line and is beaten
a full and straight ball, Narine flicks but the ball goes off the leading edge to third man
played off the front foot on the off side

caught, Karthik's come sprinting across and snatched the ball out of RP Singh's hands. RP's standing there with his hands on his hips. But Karthik's taken the catch. Bhatia slogged at a slower ball and mis-timed it high in the air towards square leg. RP Singh came running in from the boundary, keeping his eyes on the ball. The wicketkeeper Karthik was also going for the catch and just before the ball could fall into RP's hands, Karthik's gloves came into view and he caught it. RP was not pleased and Karthik said sorry. Munaf was the peacemaker
a full ball outside off, Yusuf moves forward and plays the drive to wide long-off
driven on the front foot to long-on
a short ball, but it's down leg side, Bhatia misses the pull
Bhatia's put the free-hit away, driving the ball flat over the leaping Tendulkar at cover, the length was full outside off again from RP

caught by Pollard, running back from point! Yusuf threw his bat at a full and wide ball outside off and sliced it high in the air. Pollard ran back from point, looking up at the ball, and caught it. Rayudu was running in from the boundary and pulled out just in time. He wouldn't have fared well in a collision with Pollard. But hang on, the umpires are checking to see if RP had over-stepped and replays showed he had. Yusuf's back. And it is a free hit coming up.
short ball outside off, the batsman gets beaten on the pull
length ball and Yusuf pulls between long on and deep midwicket. Rohit sprints to his right from long on and scoops the ball to Harbhajan, who was coming to help
good length ball angling across the right-hander, Bhatia cuts behind point
he's pulled the short ball but instead of hitting it through midwicket he's top-edged it over the leaping wicketkeeper for four streaky runs
the short ball this time, quick too, Yusuf bends his knees and lets it pass
this time the yorker is spot on, on middle stump, Malinga appeals because he thinks it has hit the toe, but Bhatia had managed to dig it out with his bat on the leg side
the attempted yorker but the line is poor, down leg side, Bhatia manages to get some bat on the ball to send it past the diving Karthik to the fine leg boundary
the slower ball on the pads, Yusuf works it towards fine leg
good length on of and middle stump, played off the front foot towards the off side
the first ball is down leg side, a wide
Yusuf pulls along the ground with power but once again it is to Harbhajan at midwicket. Time for that time out.
width offered outside off stump, Yusuf cuts but gets a bottom edge that goes to the third man boundary

Das has been run out, surely. Yusuf pulled the short ball with power but hit it straight to Harbhajan at midwicket. Yusuf did not want the single but Das had run a long way from the non-striker's end by the time he was forced to turn back. Harbhajan threw the ball on the bounce to Smith who broke the stumps with Das well short
good length and straight, a slower ball, Yusuf defends to the bowler
Das tries to pull but is cramped for room and rushed for time by Smith's skiddy delivery, mis-times to midwicket
Yusuf gets an outside edge that goes towards third man, the short of a length ball was well directed
sharp short ball and Das gets beaten on the hook
short of a length on middle stump, worked off the pads through square leg
good length on off stump, both batsmen decide to go for the single and then both decide against it before it is too late, Yusuf had played the ball close on the off side
short of a length and straight, Das stays back and steers towards third man
pushed off the front foot towards long off

... and he's struck first ball! Tiwary came out of his crease and tried to launch a slightly slower ball over the straight boundary. He ended up mis-hitting it over the bowler's head towards long-off. Malinga came running in from the boundary and held the catch, though the ball nearly popped out of his fingers
nudged awkwardly off the front foot on the leg side
he tries to play to third man again, but the ball cut back into the right-hander, Tiwary had to defend awkwardly in the end
Tiwary opens the face and tries to run the ball to third man but is beaten
short of a length outside off, Yusuf stays in his crease and cuts towards third man

bowled him! The length was not short enough to pull but Shakib went for it anyway. Smith is quicker than he seems and the ball skids through on the left-hander. Shakib gets a bottom edge on to leg stump and is very annoyed with himself. Swings his bat in anger/disappointment/disgust as he walks off, take your pick.
that's a poor line, outside leg stump, Shakib tries to swing behind square but misses, the ball clips the pad and goes towards fine leg and Malinga has to chase
now he charges again and slogs at a short of a length ball and is beaten, beauty followed by a beast

that is a sensational shot, Tiwary steps out of his crease, and moves outside leg stump to make room, he gets under a length ball and lofts it with a perfectly straight bat, high over the sight screen. The air time on that ball was immense
another short of a length ball, Tiwary gets out of the line and lets it pass over his stumps
Shakib tries to pull but the short ball is too quick for him, he's rushed for time and the ball goes off the glove and grille towards fine leg
the slower ball bowled fuller outside off, Tiwary stays in his crease and plays through cover
good length, pitching in line with the stumps, and angling across Shakib, who stays in his crease and pushes to mid off
It's taken a while but Tiwary has hit the innings' first six, lifting the ball cleanly over deep midwicket, he hit it with the angle and turn into him
played towards point again for a quick run
that's a bit short and Shakib cuts hard, the fielder at backward point Dwayne Smith takes pace off the ball but it is still too quick for Tendulkar, who chases from short third man
Tiwary tries to dab the ball towards third man from dangerously close to off stump, he gets beaten
Shakib moves back and works the ball through midwicket
flicked off the front foot past Gibbs at midwicket
gets forward and pushes a pitched up ball to the bowler
straight and down leg from a good length, Shakib misses the nudge
now he goes wide of the crease to angle it in, this time Tiwary gets it down to third man
even more bounce this time, bangs the offcutter into the pitch, Tiwary tries to dab it to third man but is beaten again
straight and wide from a good length, he tries to steer it but is beaten by the bounce
consecutive fours, offcutter goes very wide outside off, mid off is up, and Tiwary clobbers it past that fielder
an inside edge runs to the fine leg rope, could have easily gone onto the stumps, this one came back in from outside off, Tiwary was looking to punch it through the off side
pushes a flighted ball to vacant midwicket, Harbhajan after it, cannot prevent the second
worked through square with the spin
misses a turning ball outside leg stump as he tries to pull it away
stands outside leg stump and reaches out to push to sweeper cover
jumps outside his crease as soon as the ball is bowled, has to defend the spinning delivery off  the pad
works a tossed up ball on leg behind square
drives a pitched up ball out to sweeper cover
dabs a widish delivery to third man
they appeal for caught behind, bat was nowhere near the short ball as Tiwary tried to pull it as it went down leg
Shakib goes after his first delivery, wide one outside off, he steps out and slices it to third man
Pollard gets the biggest KKR wicket, Gambhir is done in by a length ball that takes out off stump, he tried to work it away on leg but missed
tries to guide it from off but cannot beat point again
makes room but cannot push it past point from leg stump
Gambhir goes back and bottom-edges the cut into the ground towards point
worked off the pads through midwicket again
Gambhir tries to cut but gets a top edge, slicing the ball in the air short of Tendulkar at short third man
hit towards deep midwicket
Gambhir tries to dab a flighted ball and gets an inside edge, on to pad and past off stump
comes forward and works the ball off the pads behind square
nudged off the pads towards square leg
dabbed from the crease towards third man once again
length ball with width outside off stump, Tiwary reaches for it and steers to third man
good length and straight, Tiwary stays in his crease and blocks
Gambhir goes back and waits for the ball to slant across him before dabbing to third man
a slower one outside off, steered from the crease towards third man
a full ball down leg side, that's a wide
pushed with soft hands towards cover where Pollard sprints in but can't prevent the single
short ball and the batsman ducks under it
worked off the pads behind square leg this time
Gambhir stays in his crease and opens the face late to steer a length ball from just outside off stump between the keeper and short third man
good length and straight, dabbed towards midwicket on the front foot
Tiwary has a real slog across the line at a good length ball a foot outside off, he gets beaten
fuller length on middle, Tiwary flicks towards fine leg
length ball outside off stump, Gambhir stays on the back foot and steers to third man
short of a length and at the body, Tiwary jumps up to fend the ball down on the leg side
played off the back foot towards point, the line was closer to off stump
Tiwary lunges on to the front foot in vain, he gets beaten by the outswinger that is pitched on a perfect length
good length outside off stump with some movement away from the right-hander, Tiwary chases it and tries to steer but is beaten
strays on to middle and leg stump, Gambhir uses the angle to flick through midwicket
played off the back foot on the off side
that's a bit high and much too wide outside off stump

dropped by Tendulkar on the third man boundary. There was width outside off and Gambhir slashed hard, carving the ball towards the third man boundary. Tendulkar ran to his right and was awkwardly balanced on the edge of play. The ball hit his hands and went over the rope
RP slants it across the right-hander this time and Tiwary gets an outside edge that goes on the bounce to first slip, Rohit throws at the bowler's end and concedes an overthrow
Towary moves forward and defends with bat closer to front pad this time
RP pitches on a good length outside off and bends the ball back into Tiwary, who prods forward and is beaten between bat and pad
Gambhis swings towards midwicket but mis-times the ball
played off the back foot towards point

Gambhir stays back and tries to steer the ball fine past the keeper to third man, thought I heard a noise there but no real reaction from Mumbai's players after Karthik fails to take it. Replays show he did edge it, a thick edge. A tough one to take when the keeper is standing up to the stumps
defended from the crease towards the bowler
steered towards third man
good length and straight, played on the leg side
strays on to the pads and Gambhir glances it between the keeper and Munaf at short fine leg for the innings' second boundary. Quite a bit has happened between the first and second
driven on the front foot to mid-off
Tiwary stays in his crease and steers the short of a length ball towards third man

RP Singh has demolished off stump, terrific ball first up, no doubt about that dismissal. It pitched on a good length around middle and off, angling across the right-hander from over the wicket. Kallis shaped to play from his crease and prodded at the ball with a gap between bat and pad. RP got the ball to straighten off the pitch and threaded it through the bat-pad gap, hitting the top of off stump

he's been given lbw even though he is a couple of steps outside his crease. I'll have to look at replays to be convinced about that one. McCullum took a couple of steps out and tried to play towards square leg. He missed and was hit on the pad. The batsmen were running a leg bye when the umpire raised the finger. McCullum was just too far down the pitch, in my opinion. The line may have been alright, but the height? Replays show the ball pitching outside leg stump as well. Might have missed off because of the angle. Terrible decision from Subroto Das.
good length ball angles across McCullum before bending back off the pitch, he gets cramped for room as he cuts towards point
on a good length just outside off, McCullum cuts off the back foot and plays to third man
played off the back foot to the fielder at cover point
good length around off stump, McCullum gets behind the line and defends
steered from the crease to third man
now he tries to cut one that is too close to off stump and bottom edges into the ground towards first slip
and he stays in his crease and gracefully drives a full length ball between the stumps at the bowler's end and the non-striker, sublime start for KRR

caught on the deep midwicket boundary! RP Singh has slogged him straight to midwicket and Narine is now IPL 2012's highest wicket-taker. Abdulla is the catcher. Narine's finished with 4-15, it could have been 5 for 9.
caught on the long-on boundary! Tiwary is the catcher once again, moving to his left to intercept the flat-batted slog from Malinga against a short of a length ball
the quicker short ball, Malinga backs away and slogs across the line, he makes no contact
the slower shorter ball, RP pulls awkwardly through square
Malinga backs away and flat-bats a short of a length ball towards long-on
RP slogs at the short of a length ball and gets a edge towards point
short of a length outside off, swatted back towards the bowler
defended on the leg side

that's the match, surely! Rohit's been caught by McCullum, Narine is all over Mumbai Indians. Rohit did not read the straighter one and he closed the face to work the ball on the leg side. The ball lobbed off the leading edge towards where silly point would have been. McCullum sprinted around the batsman and dived forward to take the catch
wung through midwicket for a single

dropped on the boundary and it's gone for six! Malinga charged the bowler and lofted it straight over Narine's head. Both long off and long on were onverging on the ball but it was Debabrata Das who got to it, he dropped it and the ball bounced off his hands over the rope.
Malinga doesn't read the one that goes away, gets beaten
caught at long-on! Harbhajan slogged at the one that spun away from him, dragging it from wide outside off straight down Tiwary's throat. Narine has his arms aloft, so does Tiwary
Harbhajan pushes the hat-trick ball towards mid of and runs the single

lbw, first ball! Kallis on fire. It's a short of a length skiddy ball, pitching outside off and angling into Smith, who stayed back and closed the face to play towards square leg. He missed and was hit plumb in front on the back pad. Kolkata are storming through to the finish here.

caught behind! Kallis' slower bouncer has done the trick for Kolkata. Pollard tried to hook at it and got a thick edge through to McCullum. Massive wicket for KKR. Pollard is so much more at ease against balls pitched in his half, I suspect Kallis knew that.
moves forward and plays the on-drive to long-on
stupendous drive, Rohit has dispatched the half-volley outside off wide of the fielder at long-off, hit all along the ground with terrific timing and placement
Pollard cleared his front foot and prepared to swing on the leg side but saw a fast full toss speeding towards him, had to hurry his shot and mis-timed it close on the leg side
a full toss but Pollard mis-times it towards deep square leg, he was aiming for wide long on or midwicket

Has Pollard been run out? He was nearly run out against RCB but his full length dive saved him. He didn't dive this time, did not have to, his long strides have got him home. Shakib bowled flat and wide outside off and Pollard drove to deep cover.
Pollard's hit his first ball for four! He stepped out and smashed it between deep midwicket and long on.
Rayudu's been stumped! He charged at Shakib, who saw him coming and fired the ball flat and wide outside off, slanting across the right-hander. McCullum collected and had the bails off in a flash
swept to deep square leg
more sloppy fielding, this time from Balaji at short third man, Rohit's attempt at a cover drive resulted in an outside edge and Balaji fumbled. There was a mix up between the batsman as well
the yorker to finish, Rayudu plays it towards cover. Kallis has come back well
a low full toss, Rayudu hits it to long-on where Abdulla fumbles to allow the second run. Gambhir glares.
full and straight, Rohit drives from the crease towards long off
a third dot ball in a row, Rohit cuts this one to point
good length angling into the right-hander, driven from the crease to mid-on, midwicket cuts it off, Yusuf was the fielder
good length on off stump, played towards midwicket

he's smashed the full toss right back at the bowler, charged down the pitch and hit it extremely hard. Not sure if that carried but would have been very hard to catch. Doctrove signals for the time out
worked off the pads in front of square leg for a single
driven on the front foot to long off
shot! Rayudu charges the left-arm spinner and lofts the ball with the angle into him, carting it high over the long-on boundary
driven on the front foot towards the non-striker, Abdulla dives to his right but can't make a clean save
driven towards long on for a single, tight line and length from Abdulla
goo length around off stump, the batsman stays in his crease and plays behind point

caught at fine leg! It was shortish ball, not the best Balaji has bowled. Karthik moved towards the off, swiveled and pulled, hitting it flat and straight to Yusuf on the boundary. He barely had to move to take that catch. It was a slower offcutter, in fact.
Balaji appeals after hitting Rohit's pads with one that angles into the right-hander, that was missing leg stump though
full ball angling into Karthik, he tries to flick but the leading edge lobs safely through the cover point region
played off the back foot towards point
Balaji bowled a slower bouncer wide outside off. I thought it came back enough to be just inside the tram line, but the umpire Subroto Das did not. Marginal call.
good length around off, Karthik steps forward and defend son the off side
driven to mid off on the front foot
nudged of the front foot towards midwicket
played from the crease through midwicket
he tries to sweep but misses and is hit on the pad
Karthik comes forward and gets hit on the pads
defended on the off side

Narine's appealing for lbw, he hasn't seen the off stump lying flat on the ground. Tendulkar went back to cut, maybe he thought it was the straighter one because he was severely cramped for room by the sharp, fizzing offbreak. He got an inside edge on to thigh and on to the off stump. Had that not hit the thigh, it would have hit leg stump. It turned that much.
Tendulkar did not pick that sharp offbreak, he pushed towards to defend and got an inside edge on to the pad
Tendulkar moves forward and plays towards point
that's too short and Karthik pulls to deep midwicket
width outside off but the length isn't bad, Karthik cuts but is beaten
Karthik prods outside off and gets beaten by the straighter ball
goes back quickly once again and pulls to long on
Tendulkar moved early into position to paddle the ball and ten had to wait to play it behind square
steps out of his crease and nudges off the pads behind square
played off the back foot towards cover point
too short, Karthik is quick to jump on the back foot and pull the ball hard along the ground to the deep midwicket boundary
defended on the front foot

shoddy, shoddy effort on the third man boundary. Tendulkar cut a slower ball outside off towards wide third man. Narine ran to his right and got to the ball well in time, he attempted to pick up with one hand though and let it go through him
full ball outside off stump, Tendulkar moves forward and drives to the fielder on the cover boundary
Kallis replies with a yorker, which Tendulkar digs out

stunning shot! Tendulkar moved slightly towards leg, Kallis followed him with a short of a length ball. Tendulkar created enough room to let the ball bounce off his bat as he cut it over the keeper and all the way for six. Sensational hand-eye co-ordination.
short of a length, angling into the body, Karthik moves across his crease and short-arm pulls the ball towards long leg
Karthik steps out to drive on the off side but gets an inside edge towards midwicket
played with soft hands towards cover for a single
square driven off the back foot to point
short and wide outside off, Tendulkar hits the ball firmly off the back foot but Tiwary dives to his left at cover to save three runs
goes deep into his crease and works the ball behind square
Karthik nudges the ball towards square, McCullum runs to pick up the ball
Tendulkar moves forward and clips the ball through short fine leg
short of a length outside off again, Karthik punches off the back foot but to the fielder at cover
Kallis jags the good length ball back into the right-hander, Karthik stays in his crease and defends, the ball falls at his feet
shot! He moves forward and across, leaning to the off side and clipping the ball off his pads between midwicket and mid-on
short ball outside off, Karthik jumps on to the back foot and pulls with power wide of the fielder at mid-on
short of a length outside off, Tendulkar stays back and opens the face to guide the ball to third man
digs in the bouncer first up, Tendulkar ducks

this time Doctrove has raised the finger. Gibbs is visibly unimpressed. He came forward, tried to slog sweep and missed a straight one. Did that hit him outside the line? If not, he is plumb. That hit him in line of off and middle. Plumb.
played off the back foot to wide mid-on for a quick single
goes on the back foot and works the ball on the leg side, Abdulla moves to his right and fields
played off the front foot to midwicket
Tendulkar moves towards the off side, gets down on one knee and sweeps the ball over the fielder at square leg
angles the ball into the right-hander, Gibbs moves outside leg and taps in front of square
too short this time and Tendulkar punishes the loose ball, backing away and slapping through cover
tapped from the crease towards midwicket
Gibbs steps out of his crease and defends
Gibbs gets outside the line of off stump and sweeps, but misses and is hit on the pad by the offbreak
he doesn't read the one that skids on and tries to jam his bat down in a hurry, gets an edge towards short third man
hits Tendulkar's pads with his first ball, Tendulkar tried to work the ball square but missed
played off the pads to short fine leg

silly, silly cricket from KKR. Gibbs got an inside edge past his stumps to short fine leg, Balaji's throw at the bowler's end was wide of Shakib and the fielder backing up at mid-off let the ball go through him. Four extra runs gift wrapped and presented on a platter
once again Shakib follows Gibbs and cramps him for room, he defends back to the bowler
Gibbs was trying to drive on the off side but mis-timed it to mid-on
pushed off the front foot towards mid-off, Shakib dives to his left and fields
Gibbs steps outside leg to make room to hit on the off side, Shakib follows him, Gibbs has to defend
good length on off stump, Tendulkar defends on the front foot towards the bowler
Tendulkar opens the face and plays towards point
played off the back foot towards point
the slower ball swatted towards mid-on, not timed well

what is Gibbs doing? He comes out of his crease and is met by a short of a length ball, which he fends awkwardly towards cover, where the ball falls short of the fielder. Gibbs then runs before Tendulkar sends him back. Had there been a direct hit he was a goner
Balaji's got the ball on a string, pitching on a good length outside off and jagging it past Gibbs' bat

a massive, massive appeal for lbw but umpire Doctrove shakes his head. Tendulkar was pushing forward and was hit on the pad by one that was angling into him and going on with the arm. That's hit him in line of middle stump and that is absolutely plumb. That is as out as McCullum was not out.
strays on to the pads, Gibbs nudges to midwicket for a single
tight line and length, Gibbs defends on the front foot again
that's wide down leg side
Gibbs makes a bit of room by moving towards leg, Shakib follows him, defended on the front foot
tossed up on off and middle, Gibbs blocks on the front foot
Gibbs strides forward and defends on the off side
Balaji nips the ball back into the right-hander and hits the pad, the ball goes behind point for a leg bye
length outside off, Gibbs cuts off the back foot to point
beaten outside off stump once again, more movement away from Gibbs for Balaji
a peach of an outswinger, pitching on a good length just outside off and shaping away, Gibbs was squared up in his crease and beaten
short and wide outside off, a hit-me ball, Gibbs hits it off the back foot in front of point and through the in field
good length outside off, Gibbs moves forward and blocks
